messages:
emma_sales: Quick help needed  BrightSoft POC: console shows some requests with trace links missing; Splunk rows also missing trace_id. They saw bursts of 429s during a bulk demo. Can we swarm for a short fix? :boom:

ryan_se: on it. Do we have one example request + forwarder log line? That will tell us if header reaches our gateway and is dropped later.

emma_sales: pasted from their ticket (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate 200
Headers: { Authorization: Bearer REDACTED, X-Trace-Id: z9y8x7, traceparent: 00-z9y8x7...-01 }
Client log:
[2026-03-22T09:45:10Z] WARN status=429 request=req_789 trace=z9y8x7
[2026-03-22T09:45:11Z] INFO forwarder: sent to hec status=ok trace=
```

ryan_se: that indicates header made it to our gateway but HEC events sometimes lack the trace field. Two likely causes: (1) exporter didn't attach metadata.trace_id, or (2) their forwarder strips headers/samples large events.

olga_sre: I can quickly: (a) check exporter logs for missing metadata.trace_id for org=brightsoft, (b) inspect Splunk drain sampling rules, (c) temporarily bump POC token qps to avoid 429s during demo. Need approval for a short window.

emma_sales: I can approve a 15-minute increase. Demo in 30m.

olga_sre: bumped token qps to 6rps for org=brightsoft for 15m and turned on debug export logging.

deploy-bot: runtime change: poc-qps-bump -> org-brightsoft (owner: olga_sre). Canary: 5% traffic.

deploy-bot: canary OK. Rolled to 100%.

ryan_se: deployed tiny canary to copy trace header into event.metadata.trace_id if present (order: metadata.trace_id || X-Trace-Id || traceparent). Deploying to p-prod-canary now.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: export-copy-trace v0.4.0 -> p-prod-canary (owner: ryan_se)
deploy-bot: canary health: 7/7 checks passed, 2% traffic routed.

ryan_se: verified on canary: exported events now include metadata.trace_id=z9y8x7; Splunk HEC rows show matching id.

emma_sales: great. Any short HOWTO I should send to BrightSoft ops?

olga_sre: send these three items:
1) If using an intermediate forwarder, preserve `X-Trace-Id` or write trace into `metadata.trace_id`.
2) Create Splunk HEC drain with `map_trace_id=metadata.trace_id`. Example payload:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/drains \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <org-token>" \n  -d '{"type":"splunk_hec","url":"https://splunk.brightsoft:8088/services/collector","token":"HEC_TOKEN","map_trace_id":"metadata.trace_id"}'
```
3) If they need full fidelity for the demo, request `trace_sampling: full` (warning: increases export volume).

marc_security: security note: confirm HEC endpoint uses TLS and token scoped to ingest-only. Also record BrightSoft approval for the 15m qps bump in the security log.

emma_sales: BrightSoft confirmed TLS + ingest-only token and approved the 15m bump. I'll schedule a 10-min call to walk through header passthrough. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
